_help: Data for the PrefabColliders op (cs/EnvOps3.cs), passed automatically by bo.py. box = assets that get ONE BoxCollider from their local bounds. cylinder = 'Asset:MeshChild' pairs that get a convex cylinder collider fitted to that mesh child (round props, boilers, pipes). stairs = 'Asset:MeshChild:treadDepthMetres' entries that get a solid wedge under the nose line of the steps (so the CharacterController walks up a ramp instead of tripping on every riser).
